text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a game of billiards with Trainer, 
Sirius Symboli realized she was in a slump 
and decided to postpone her overseas 
campaign.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By constantly avoiding facing her true 
feelings of wanting to return to how 
things used to be with Symboli Rudolf, 
Sirius Symboli's heart continues to be 
eaten away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to not lose sight of her true 
dream, she needed to reclaim her original 
radiance, at least by the time of the next 
race, the Kikuka Sho.
